mapper.select: SELECT room_id AS roomId, name, description, shelve_number AS shelveNumber, animal_cage_number AS animalCageNumber, rent_animal_cage_number AS rentAnimalCageNumber, used_animal_cage_number AS usedAnimalCageNumber, last_rent_number AS lastRentNumber, memo FROM cage_booking_room ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_booking_room (room_id, animal_cage_number, synced_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{capacity}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE animal_cage_number = VALUES(animal_cage_number), synced_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO cage_booking_room (room_id, name, description, shelve_number, animal_cage_number, rent_animal_cage_number, used_animal_cage_number, last_rent_number, memo, synced_at) VALUES
(#{r.roomId}, #{r.name}, #{r.description}, #{r.shelveNumber}, #{r.animalCageNumber}, #{r.rentAnimalCageNumber}, #{r.usedAnimalCageNumber}, #{r.lastRentNumber}, #{r.memo}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), shelve_number = VALUES(shelve_number), animal_cage_number = VALUES(animal_cage_number), rent_animal_cage_number = VALUES(rent_animal_cage_number), used_animal_cage_number = VALUES(used_animal_cage_number), last_rent_number = VALUES(last_rent_number), memo = VALUES(memo), synced_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT aro_id AS id, room_id AS roomId, name, pi_name AS piName, register_number AS registerNumber, aup_id AS aupId, rent_number AS rentNumber, used_animal_cage_number AS usedAnimalCageNumber, memo, begin_time AS beginTime, end_time AS endTime FROM cage_booking_room_aup WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT a.room_id AS roomId, COALESCE(r.name, '') AS roomName FROM cage_booking_room_aup a LEFT JOIN cage_booking_room r ON a.room_id = r.room_id WHERE a.register_number = #{registerNo} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.room_id

SELECT a.aup_id AS aupId, a.room_id AS roomId, COALESCE(r.name, '') AS roomName, a.pi_name AS piName, a.register_number AS registerNumber, a.rent_number AS rentNumber FROM cage_booking_room_aup a LEFT JOIN cage_booking_room r ON a.room_id = r.room_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND (a.register_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.pi_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY a.id ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO cage_booking_room_aup (aro_id, room_id, name, pi_name, register_number, aup_id, rent_number, used_animal_cage_number, memo, begin_time, end_time, synced_at) VALUES
(#{a.aroId}, #{a.roomId}, #{a.name}, #{a.piName}, #{a.registerNumber}, #{a.aupId}, #{a.rentNumber}, #{a.usedAnimalCageNumber}, #{a.memo}, #{a.beginTime}, #{a.endTime}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE room_id = VALUES(room_id), name = VALUES(name), pi_name = VALUES(pi_name), register_number = VALUES(register_number), aup_id = VALUES(aup_id), rent_number = VALUES(rent_number), used_animal_cage_number = VALUES(used_animal_cage_number), memo = VALUES(memo), begin_time = VALUES(begin_time), end_time = VALUES(end_time), synced_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO cage_booking_room_aup (aro_id, room_id, name, pi_name, register_number, aup_id, rent_number, memo, deleted, synced_at) VALUES (#{aroId}, #{roomId}, #{name}, #{piName}, #{registerNumber}, #{aupId}, #{rentNumber}, #{memo}, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE room_id = VALUES(room_id), name = VALUES(name), pi_name = VALUES(pi_name), register_number = VALUES(register_number), aup_id = VALUES(aup_id), rent_number = VALUES(rent_number), memo = VALUES(memo), deleted = 0, synced_at = NOW()
